about.heading: About Me
about.content: I am a software engineer and systems architect focused on building robust, modular, and high-impact technical solutions. My experience spans building 3-way supply chain reconciliation & audit copilot engines for complex enterprise operations (ReconcileAI), orchestrating AI agent pipelines with deterministic guardrails and Human-in-the-Loop oversight, and designing decoupled game architectures (Pure C# Domain, Service Locator, Event Bus, and custom editor tooling in Unity 6). I prioritize Spec-Driven Development (SDD), isolated unit testing, and operational observability.
